Detailed Steps: 1. Open the Admin Portal URL in your browser (e.g. .../admin or the URL provided by your team). 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Admin Login page should open. 2. You should see fields for email and password (and possibly a "Sign in" or "Login" button). 3. The page title or header may show "KivuIMS Admin" or similar. 4. No blank screen or technical error.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Admin Login page enter the email of a user with PRIMARY_SUPER_ADMIN or SECONDARY_SUPER_ADMIN role. 2. Enter the correct password. 3. Click Login or Sign in. 4. Complete OTP if the application asks for it.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. You should be redirected to the Admin Dashboard (URL should contain "/dashboard"). 2. The left sidebar should show menu items: Dashboard, Companies, Membership, Subscriptions, Payments, Admin Users, Add Admin User. 3. The top bar should show the logged-in role (e.g. "Primary Super Admin" or "Secondary Super Admin"). 4. No "Access denied" or redirect back to login.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Admin Login page enter a valid email format but use a wrong password (or an email that is not a super admin). 2. Click Login.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Login should fail. 2. An error message should appear (e.g. "Invalid credentials" or "Access denied"). 3. You should remain on the login page. 4. You should NOT see the dashboard.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Admin Login page enter the email and password of a user who has a company role (e.g. COMPANY_ADMIN or STORE_ADMIN) but is NOT a super admin. 2. Click Login. 3. Complete OTP if shown.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The application should either reject login with an "Access denied" message or redirect to the end-user portal (not the admin dashboard). 2. You should NOT see the admin sidebar (Dashboard, Companies, Membership, etc.). 3. Note the actual behavior in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Admin Login page leave email and password blank. 2. Click Login.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not submit successfully. 2. Validation message(s) should appear (e.g. "Email is required" or "Please fill in required fields"). 3. You remain on the login page.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in to the Admin Portal as a super admin. 2. In the left sidebar click "Dashboard" (first menu item). 3. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The main content should show the Admin Dashboard. 2. You should see KPI cards (e.g. Total Companies, Active Subscriptions, Revenue, Active Super Admins) and optionally a date range selector. 3. The URL should contain "/dashboard" and the Dashboard item should appear selected. 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. In the Admin Portal sidebar click "Companies". 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Companies page should open. 2. You should see a list of companies (table or cards) or an empty state. 3. The URL should contain "/dashboard/companies". 4. No blank screen or infinite loading.

Detailed Steps: 1. In the sidebar click "Membership". 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Membership management page should open (plans, features, billing cycles, or navigation to them). 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/membership". 3. Content should load without errors.

Detailed Steps: 1. In the sidebar click "Subscriptions". 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Subscriptions page should open with a list of subscriptions or empty state. 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/subscriptions". 3. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. In the sidebar click "Payments". 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Payments page should open with a list of payments or empty state. 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/payments". 3. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. In the sidebar click "Admin Users". 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Admin Users list page should open. 2. You should see a list of super-admin users or empty state. 3. The URL should contain "/dashboard/admin-users". 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. In the sidebar click "Add Admin User". 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Add Admin User form/page should open. 2. You should see fields to create a new super-admin user (e.g. email, role). 3. The URL should contain "/dashboard/add-admin-user". 4. If your backend restricts this to primary only: a secondary super admin may see "Access denied" or the menu item hidden; note in Spotted Problems.
Allowed roles: PRIMARY_SUPER_ADMIN only (SECONDARY may have no access)

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in to the Admin Portal. 2. In the left sidebar at the bottom click "Log out". 3. Wait for the action to complete.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. You should be redirected to the Admin Login page. 2. The dashboard and sidebar should no longer be visible. 3. If you try to open the dashboard URL again without logging in, you should be redirected to login. 4. No error message.

Test Case: Dashboard - KPI cards and date range
Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and go to the Dashboard. 2. Look at the KPI cards (Total Companies, Active Subscriptions, Revenue, Active Super Admins). 3. If a date range selector is present, select a date range (e.g. Last 7 days or custom). 4. Wait for data to update if applicable.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The KPI cards should show values (numbers or "—" if no data). 2. Selecting a date range should update the analytics (e.g. "in period" values). 3. No broken layout or missing labels. 4. Loading state (e.g. "…") may appear briefly then resolve. Note any incorrect or missing data in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open the Dashboard when the backend has no data (or when the API is slow). 2. Observe the initial load and any empty state.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should load without crashing. 2. You should see either placeholder values (e.g. "—"), a loading indicator, or a clear empty state. 3. No unhandled error or blank white screen. 4. Note the actual behavior in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Dashboard > Companies. 2. Wait for the list to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A table or list of companies should appear (columns may include name, registration number, status, actions). 2. Or an empty state with a message like "No companies". 3. No infinite loading or error. 4. Pagination or scroll if many companies.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Companies list click a company row or "View" link. 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A company detail page should open showing company information (name, address, status, stores, etc.). 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/companies/" and the company ID. 3. You may see actions such as Activate/Deactivate or Approve. 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a company detail page. 2. If the company is pending or suspended, find "Approve" or "Activate". If active, find "Deactivate" or "Suspend". 3. Click the action and confirm if asked.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The action should complete and a success message may appear. 2. The company status should update on the page or list. 3. If the feature is not in your build, note "N/A" in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Dashboard > Membership. 2. Navigate to Plans (if Membership is a hub) or go directly to Dashboard > Plans if available. 3. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A list of membership plans should appear (name, price, billing cycle, etc.) or an empty state. 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/plans" or "/dashboard/membership". 3. You may be able to open a plan detail. 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. From the Plans list click a plan to open its detail. 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The plan detail page should open (name, features, pricing, billing cycles). 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/plans/" and the plan ID. 3. You may see links to features or plan pricing. 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Dashboard > Subscriptions. 2. Wait for the list to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A table or list of subscriptions should appear (company, plan, status, dates, etc.) or an empty state. 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/subscriptions". 3. You may be able to open a subscription detail. 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Subscriptions list click a subscription row or "View". 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A subscription detail page should open (company, plan, status, start/end dates, actions). 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/subscriptions/" and the subscription ID. 3. You may see actions like Extend or Cancel. 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Dashboard > Payments. 2. Wait for the list to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A table or list of payments should appear (amount, date, subscription, status, etc.) or an empty state. 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/payments". 3. You may be able to open a payment detail. 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Dashboard > Admin Users. 2. Wait for the list to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A list of super-admin users should appear (email, role, status, etc.) or an empty state. 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/admin-users". 3. You may be able to open a user detail. 4. No error or blank content.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Admin Users list click a user row or "View". 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. An admin user detail page should open (email, role, dates, etc.). 2. The URL should contain "/dashboard/admin-users/" and the user ID. 3. No error or blank content. 4. Note in Spotted Problems if edit/delete is available.

Test Case: Add Admin User - form and validation
Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Dashboard > Add Admin User (as primary super admin). 2. Leave required fields empty and click Submit. 3. Then fill in required fields (e.g. email, role) and submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. With empty required fields: validation messages should appear and no user should be created. 2. With valid data: the form should submit and a success message should appear; the new admin may appear in the Admin Users list. 3. If you are logged in as SECONDARY_SUPER_ADMIN and this page is accessible, note whether the backend allows creation or returns an error; note in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. Do NOT log in to the Admin Portal. 2. In the browser address bar type the direct URL to the dashboard (e.g. .../admin/dashboard or .../dashboard). 3. Press Enter.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. You should be redirected to the Admin Login page. 2. You should NOT see the dashboard or any admin data. 3. After logging in as super admin, you may be redirected back to the dashboard.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in to the Admin Portal and go to a page (e.g. Companies or Subscriptions). 2. Press F5 or use the browser Refresh button. 3. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should reload and show the same content. 2. You should NOT see a blank white screen. 3. You should NOT be redirected to login unless the session expired. 4. The URL should remain correct.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in to the Admin Portal on a mobile device or resize the browser to a narrow width (e.g. phone). 2. Look for a menu (hamburger) icon in the top bar. 3. Tap or click it to open the sidebar. 4. Tap a menu item (e.g. Companies). 5. Optionally close the drawer.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The sidebar should be hidden by default and open when the menu icon is clicked. 2. Tapping a menu item should navigate to that page and the content should display. 3. The drawer may close after navigation. 4. No overlap or layout break. Note any issues in Spotted Problems.
